definitions.gloss: center, hub, nerve center, central authority
definitions.explanation: The central controlling part of an organization, system, or body. The place where key decisions are made or key functions are controlled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中枢|ちゅうすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担|にな}う→担う：12787_ninau⟧。
examples.english: To play a central role in politics.

examples.japanese: {中枢|ちゅうすう}⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{制御|せいぎょ}→制御：11816_seigyo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The central nervous system controls the body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中枢|ちゅうすう}にいて、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かか}わって→関わる：03020_kakawaru⟧きた。
examples.english: She has been at the center of government for many years and has been involved in many policies.
